recommendation: Keep the commit. The fix is limited to active OperationDefinition wording, preserves FHIR-13240 stats behavior, and aligns the operation with the current Observation model established by FHIR-10118.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive OO issue requesting fixes to the Observation stats operation after discussion identified gaps around panel codes, component codes, entered-in-error observations, and modifier extensions.
initial_application: GF#13240 was applied in October 2017 commits 16acde1238aab4786f34b599766929e3d5721a23, b6ad40bbc2f5218d7e9e1f848ed862a726753c49, and 29d523c8173d2ffd355d5606e88092c6917df0f5. Those commits introduced the operation text explaining that panel-code statistics include member observations and component observations, using the then-current Observation.related path.
additional_context: FHIR-10118 later replaced Observation.related relationship-type codes with explicit Observation.hasMember and Observation.derivedFrom elements. Current Observation source contains hasMember and derivedFrom but no related element. FHIR-44836 is already represented on the combined branch and made the same terminology correction in the Vital Signs Panel profile definition.
reconciliation: Changed source/observation/operationdefinition-Observation-stats.xml so the stats operation code parameter documentation says panel member observations are referenced in Observation.hasMember rather than .related with related.type = has-member.
source_changes: source/observation/operationdefinition-Observation-stats.xml: replaced obsolete .related/related.type=has-member panel-member wording with Observation.hasMember.
